_readme: [MKT-3GROUP-1 2026-09-05] THE canonical marketplace taxonomy. Every language mirror (worker TS, web TS, Flutter Dart) and the D1 seed for listing_categories are generated FROM THIS FILE, mechanically, so four agents working in parallel cannot drift. Prose, rationale and the wording rules are in Specs/SPEC-2026-09-05-THREE-GROUPS-AND-HOURLY-PRICING.md — read that first. If you change an id here, you are renaming a value that is stored in listings.category on live rows: write the backfill UPDATE in the same migration or those rows silently fall out of every group.

pricing._readme: Per participant, PER HOUR, in tokens (1 token = ₹1). fee = flat + round((price - flat) * commission_pct / 100); creator = price - fee. A 2-hour booking bills the flat fee twice (owner: 'per 1 hour'). The SERVER recomputes this; a client-computed fee must never reach a ledger row.

media_mode._readme: listings.media_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'audio_video'. Picked by the creator in wizard step 2. THIS SPEC LANDS THE FIELD ONLY — wiring it into the GetStream call UI is separate work.

rules.audio_only: The video control is not shown at all while streaming or in a 1:1 — the creator never appears on camera.
rules.audio_video: The creator may NOT turn video off. They sold a video session; one that becomes audio-only mid-way is a refund.

_hidden_sections_note: [AGENT-LIVE-1 2026-09-12] EMPTY ON PURPOSE. ai_voice_agents was hidden outright on 2026-09-05 ([MKT-3GROUP-1]) and UN-hidden on 2026-09-12 when AI voice agent listings shipped: it is now a real section of book_their_time, gated at runtime by the agentListingsEnabled flag rather than by this list. Kept as a key so the generator still emits an (empty) HIDDEN_SECTIONS / kHiddenListingSections and a future hide-this-section decision has one place to go. On 2026-09-13 a regeneration for [LISTING-CAT-PUJA-1] silently reverted the 09-12 change because it lived only as a hand-edit in the GENERATED mirrors — which is why it now lives here instead.
